title: COP31 AI-Enabled Cleantech concept note
evidence:
A pilot is considered launched once it has a defined challenge owner, technology provider, 
implementation site, agreed workplan, baseline, impact measurement plan, financing pathway and 
implementation start date.

Each pilot tests the responsible application of AI to a clearly defined climate or resource-efficiency 
challenge. The pilots generate evidence on technical performance, climate and development 
outcomes, implementation requirements, environmental footprint and potential for replication
